methodologyNotes: Covers modern cam-and-pulley compound hunting and target bows (bare bow, riser + limbs + cams + strings) sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes recurves, longbows, crossbows, and ready-to-hunt accessory packages priced with sights/rests/quivers bundled (price reflects the bare-bow MSRP, USD). iboSpeedFps is the manufacturer-published IBO/ATA arrow speed rating in feet per second (measured at 70 lb peak, 30 in draw, 350 gr arrow per the standard). axleToAxleLengthIn is axle-to-axle length in inches. braceHeightIn is brace height (string-to-grip throat) in inches. drawWeightRangeLbs is the peak draw-weight adjustment range in pounds, written as a low-high string (e.g. "55-70"). drawLengthRangeIn is the draw-length adjustment range in inches, written as a low-high string (e.g. "25-31.5"). letOffPercent is the manufacturer-stated let-off percentage; where multiple let-off settings are offered, the maximum is used. massWeightLbs is the bare-bow physical mass weight in pounds. camSystem is an enum of the cam configuration: single-cam, hybrid-cam, binary-cam, or dual-cam. riserMaterial is an enum: aluminum or carbon. handOrientation is an enum of available hand orientations: right, left, or both.

products.name: Mathews ARC 34
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,569. The official Mathews product page states "MSRP: Starting at $1569" with a regular price of "$1,569.00 USD". The GOHUNT in-depth review spec table lists MSRP "$1,569.00" and the article states "The MSRP for the ARC 34 is $1,569."
products.provenance: The official Mathews product page (mathewsinc.com/products/arc-34) and the Mathews ARC platform page list the ARC 34 at 34" axle-to-axle, 6.5" brace height, IBO up to 343 FPS, 26.5"-32" draw lengths, 55/60/65/70/75/80 lb draw weights, 80 or 85% let-off, 4.3 lb physical weight, SWX-2 cam, and "MSRP: Starting at $1569" / regular price "$1,569.00 USD" — confirming this is the exact 2026 ARC 34, distinct from the ARC 30 sibling (30" ATA, 6" brace, 348 FPS, $1,459). The GOHUNT in-depth review (Dec 26, 2025) reproduces an identical ARC 34 spec table and states "The MSRP for the ARC 34 is $1,569," corroborating both the specs and the price. The cam configuration enum (single/hybrid/binary/dual — pages give only the marketing name "SWX-2"), riser material (aluminum/carbon), and hand orientation were not explicitly stated on any fetched page, so those three keys are null.

products.name: Hoyt Alpha AX-3 33
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,599, per the Field & Stream review (fieldandstream.com): quick-specs box "MSRP: $1,599" and body text "MSRP sits at $1,599 — a significant investment that positions this bow at the top of the aluminum-riser market." Hoyt's own product page lists no price (bows are dealer-sold; cart shows a $0.00 placeholder).
products.provenance: Hoyt's official product page (source.url), titled "Alpha AX-3 33 Hunting Compound Bow," confirms this exact standard 33 model — distinct from the AX-3 33 LD, AX-3 SD, and AX-3 29 also listed in its own bow menu — and its spec panel provides 340 FPS (ATA), 4.75 lb mass weight, 6 3/8 in brace height, 40-80 lb draw weight, and 26-31 in draw length; it lists no price (dealer-sold). The Field & Stream review corroborates the exact 2026 aluminum-riser Alpha AX-3 33, matching 340 fps and a 6-3/8 in brace height, confirming the aluminum riser, and stating the US MSRP as $1,599. Axle-to-axle was left null (Hoyt's spec panel shows 33 9/16 in while both reviews state 33-5/16 in) and let-off was left null (Hoyt gives no figure while the reviews list conflicting sets of 70/75/80 vs 75/80/85 percent); camSystem is null because the "HBX Gen 4" cam is not stated in any of the allowed enum terms, and handOrientation is null as neither page states it for this product.

products.name: Bowtech Alliance
products.priceNote: Official Bowtech product page lists the Alliance "Starting at $1499"; Hunting Retailer review lists "MSRP : $1,499.99". Using $1499 (bare-bow MSRP, USD) as it appears verbatim on the manufacturer page.
products.provenance: The official Bowtech product page confirms the base Alliance (Mass Weight 4.09 LBS, Draw Length 26"-31", Draw Weight 60/65/70/75 LBS, Speed 338 FPS, Axle to Axle 30.5", Brace Height 6.43") and lists the price as "Starting at $1499". The Hunting Retailer review (dated March 25, 2026) independently confirms the same 30.5" axle-to-axle, 6.43" brace height, 338 fps and 4.09 lb figures, states MSRP $1,499.99, and adds Let-off 80/85%. Both pages explicitly distinguish this base 30.5" Alliance from the longer 33" Alliance 33 (rated 334 fps), verifying this is the exact base Alliance model and not the sibling variant.

products.name: PSE Sicario
products.priceNote: Lancaster Archery Supply lists the "PSE Sicario Carbon Compound Hunting Bow" (Item #1043855) at $1,999.00 (bare-bow price). PSE's official product page publishes no MSRP (shows only "Find a Dealer"), so this figure is the retailer's typical US price.
products.provenance: The official PSE Archery product page (psearchery.com/products/sicario-carbon-fds) confirms the model identity as the 2026 PSE Sicario carbon bow and lists BOW SPECIFICATIONS verbatim: FDS cam, brace height 5-1/4", axle to axle 33", IBO 357 fps, let-off 75%-85% (70/75/80/85), mass weight 3.9 lbs, draw length 24-1/2"-30", draw weights 50/60/70/80 lbs, and a Dead Frequency Carbon riser; it publishes no price. Lancaster Archery Supply corroborates every spec (Axle-to-Axle 33", Brace Height 5.25", Let-Off 70/75/80/85%, IBO 357FPS, Mass 3.9lbs, Draw Length 24.5"-30", Max Draw Weight 50/60/70/80lbs, Dexterity RH and LH) and provides the price of $1,999.00 for the exact item (#1043855). This is the base 33"/357fps Sicario, distinct from the separate "Sicario 35" (336 fps, 35" ATA) model, so identity is confirmed; cam configuration is only named "FDS Cam System" on both pages with no single/dual/binary/hybrid classification, so camSystem is left null.

products.name: Elite Varos
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,299.99 for standard/hunting colors, listed as "Regular price $1,299.99" on the official Elite Archery Varos product page and corroborated as "$1,299.99 in standard colors" by the Bowhunting.com review (target finishes listed at $1,399.99; the bare-bow standard-color price is used).
products.provenance: The official Elite Archery product page (elitearchery.com/products/varos) confirms this is the exact Varos model and lists a "Regular price $1,299.99" plus a full BOW SPECS block: 32" axle-to-axle, 6.625" (6 5/8") brace height, 4.75 lb weight, 25.5"-31" draw length, peak weights of 40, 50, 60, 65, 70 & 75 lb, up-to-90% let-off, 338 FPS IBO speed, and RH & LH availability. The dated Bowhunting.com "2026 Elite Varos Bow Review" (published Oct 24, 2025, updated Mar 2, 2026) corroborates the same model and $1,299.99 standard price, plus the 32" A2A, 338 FPS, 6 5/8" brace, 25.5"-31" draw and 40-75 lb weight range; it lists mass weight as 4.55 lb versus the manufacturer's 4.75 lb, so the authoritative manufacturer figure (4.75) is used. Cam-system enum (the "SP2 Cam System" is not described as single/hybrid/binary/dual) and riser material are not explicitly stated on either page, so both are left null.

products.name: Prime Divide 33
products.priceNote: Lancaster Archery Supply's "Prime Divide 33 Compound Hunting Bow" product page (Item # 1044460) lists the bare-bow price verbatim as "$1,595.00", used here as the US retail figure. G5 Prime does not publish a numeric MSRP on its own site, so this retailer price is the sourced value.
products.provenance: The G5 Prime manufacturer lineup page (g5prime.com/divide/) lists the DIVIDE 33 with "ATA 33", "WEIGHT 4.1lbs", "DRAW WEIGHT 40-80LBS", and "IBO SPEED (FPS) 339 | 331" for the 6"/7" brace options, confirming this exact 2026 model. Lancaster Archery Supply's Prime Divide 33 page (Item # 1044460) corroborates every spec verbatim — Axle-to-Axle 33", Let-Off 83% (80% w/performance mod), Mass Weight 4.1lbs, Prime CORE Cam — and shows the bare-bow price "$1,595.00"; the 2026 Extreme Outfitters review independently repeats the same figures and XSpot Archery sells a "Left Hand" Divide 33 (right hand is the standard configuration), so handOrientation is "both". Because brace height (6"/7"), IBO speed (339/331), and draw length (26-30"/27-31") differ between the two brace-height configurations, braceHeightIn and drawLengthRangeIn are left null; iboSpeedFps uses the published headline 339 fps rating, and the Core cam type and hybrid carbon/aluminum AST riser are not classified into the spec enums by any source, so camSystem and riserMaterial are null.

products.name: Bear Redeem
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,299.99 stated verbatim on the official Bear Archery product page (bare bow, premium Legend Series, SKU AV6KA80026R; all color/hand/draw-weight variants listed at $1,299.99). Corroborated at "$1,299.99 USD" on the Arrows Unlimited retailer page for the same 2026 Bear Redeem.
products.provenance: The official Bear Archery page identifies this exact model as the Redeem, the brand's flagship 2026 Legend Series compound bow (SKU AV6KA80026R), and states verbatim: axle-to-axle 30", brace height 6.25", IBO speeds up to 340 FPS, draw length 25"-30", two draw-weight ranges (45-60 and 55-70), and let-off at 80% or 85%, priced at $1,299.99. The Arrows Unlimited retailer page corroborates the identical 2026 Bear Redeem with the same axle-to-axle, speed, draw length, draw-weight ranges, let-off, and a $1,299.99 USD price. drawWeightRangeLbs uses the peak module 55-70 (both 45-60 and 55-70 are offered); massWeightLbs, camSystem (only "EKO² Cam System" named, not a single/hybrid/binary/dual configuration), and riserMaterial were not stated verbatim on either page and are left null. letOffPercent uses the maximum (85) per methodology.

Speed"), Axle-to-Axle 32 inches, Brace Height 7.25", Let-Off 85%, Mass Weight 3.6 pounds, draw weight range 7-70 pounds, draw length 15-31 inches, Synchronized Binary Cam System — and explicitly distinguishes it from sibling models (Edge Pro at 7" brace, Infinite Edge), confirming model identity; it also notes a left-hand model is offered alongside the standard right-hand bow (hence handOrientation "both").
